concerns.text: The Constitution Check table asserts compliance with Principle VI but does not mention the required exemption for the historic constitution title containing the forbidden term “First‑Principles”. The audit script is expected to record this exemption, but the plan should explicitly state that the constitution title is exempt per Section 4b of the spec.

The plan references the contract `graph.schema.yaml` in the contracts directory, yet no task produces or validates a file against this schema. All graph data is validated only by `dataset_schema.yaml`. Either add a task that validates individual graph objects against `graph.schema.yaml` or remove the unused contract reference.
